name: orchestrator
description: Multi-agent project orchestration for repos governed by a Linear team: round-based execution with tiered executors in git worktrees, a mixed-tier merge-gate workflow, reflect passes against acceptance criteria, checkpoint/halt-state discipline, interactive review-queue closeout (/close-issues), and an interactive learnings loop (/lessons-review). Execution-side counterpart to project-coordinator.

interface.shortDescription: Run governed multi-agent delivery rounds from Linear.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate tiered executors in isolated worktrees, enforce merge gates and checkpoints, reflect against acceptance criteria, work the review queue interactively, and capture approved process lessons for Linear-governed repositories.
defaultPrompt: Run the next governed execution round.
Work through the Linear review queue with me.
Review the lessons from this delivery round.
